conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { const body = $json.body; if (body.action !== 'created') return false; if (!body.issue || !body.issue.pull_request) return false; if (body.sender && body.sender.type === 'Bot') return false; const allowed = ($env.N8N_MERGE_AUTHORIZED_LOGINS || '').split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean); if (!allowed.includes(body.sender && body.sender.login)) return false; const text = ((body.comment && body.comment.body) || '').trim(); return /^\/merge\b/i.test(text); })() }}

parameters.command:
=set +e
set -o pipefail
PR={{ $json.prNumber }}
METHOD="{{ $json.mergeMethod }}"
REPO="{{ $json.repoFull }}"
PR_TITLE={{ JSON.stringify($json.prTitle) }}
PR_URL="{{ $json.prUrl }}"
QA_LOGIN="{{ $json.qaLogin }}"
cd ~/workspace || exit 10
_URL=$(git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null)
_T="${_URL#*x-access-token:}"
export GH_TOKEN="${_T%%@*}"
gh pr merge "$PR" --"$METHOD" --delete-branch --repo "$REPO" 2>&1
MERGE_RC=$?
echo "MERGE_RC=$MERGE_RC"
if [ $MERGE_RC -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "SMOKE_URL="
  exit 0
fi
BODY="/tmp/smoke-body-$PR.md"
cat > "$BODY" <<EOF
Smoke-test request for merged PR $PR_URL.

Flows to verify:
- Pull latest main locally or from the \`pr-${PR}-build\` build artefacts.
- Walk the golden path described in the PR body above.
- Exploratory pass on both iOS and Android clients.

Close this issue when verification is complete. File a new issue (link it back here) for any regressions discovered.
EOF
SMOKE_OUT=$(gh issue create --repo "$REPO" \
  --title "Smoke test: $PR_TITLE" \
  --assignee "$QA_LOGIN" \
  --label smoke-test \
  --body-file "$BODY" 2>&1)
SMOKE_RC=$?
rm -f "$BODY"
echo "SMOKE_RC=$SMOKE_RC"
echo "SMOKE_OUT<<__END__"
echo "$SMOKE_OUT"
echo "__END__"
SMOKE_URL=$(printf '%s\n' "$SMOKE_OUT" | grep -Eo 'https://github.com/[^ ]+/issues/[0-9]+' | tail -1)
echo "SMOKE_URL=$SMOKE_URL"
exit 0

Smoke-test issue: ${smokeUrl}`; return `Merged. (Smoke-test issue creation failed — see workflow logs.)`; })() }}
